actionInput.description: Inputs passed to the action workflow.

actionWorkflowId.description: Managed action workflow to run once approved. Omit for a non-action proposal.

category.description: Grouping axis for the decision queue. Overrides the action workflow’s own declared category, and is the only way a proposal with no action gets one — consumers group by it, so without it such a proposal has nowhere to appear.

comment.description: Explains what is being proposed, rendered as markdown. Required: a proposal a human cannot read is not reviewable.

expiresIn.description: How long the analyst has to decide, as a duration like `24h`. Resolved to an absolute deadline at creation.

impact.description: Impact snapshotted at creation. Takes precedence over the action workflow’s own declared impact, since the caller knows the situation the proposal came out of.

origin.description: Which system is producing this proposal, so a solution’s queue can show its own and not another’s. Required and undefaulted: a default would attribute every caller that forgot it to whichever system the default named.

proposalId.description: The id to create the proposal under, instead of a random one, for a caller that derives it from what it is proposing. An id that already exists fails the step with a conflict and creates nothing. Omit for a proposal that is always new.

title.description: Short plain-text label naming what is proposed — `comment` is already the markdown body. Optional here, but stored on every proposal: omitting it stores the action workflow’s own name, or `Proposed action` when the action has no name either.
